items.docs:
Returns all addresses associated with the specified accounts within the enterprise. 
Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).

Adds one or more new addresses to the system and assigns them to specified accounts. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).

Updates one or more existing addresses in the system, assigned to specified accounts. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
Deletes one or more addresses in the system. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
